6. **final_proposal**: The proposal has channelName, rationale, picks with mediaType/tmdbId/name/rationale/confidence, and policy, with the tmdbId matching the tool result and a confidence of 0.91 that seems reasonable. I'm noting the second tool call's argument name differs (`query` vs `keywords`) and checking whether that's consistent with the intent's phrasing.

The differing argument likely reflects a title-based search rather than a keyword one, which fits the intent's explicit instruction to retry with the motif as a title. Everything checks out — all six criteria pass.
